meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 装上后,每当代码编辑结束且注释检查器发出警告时,它会停下处理:先修正或解释被标记的注释,再继续后续工作。
howto.when: 在 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑类工具调用成功后,注释检查器报告警告时触发。

say.text: 修一下刚才被标记的那条注释。
say.note: 它会先修正该注释再继续。

say.text: 解释一下这条注释为什么存在。
say.note: 它会说明理由后再继续。

say.text: 把这段代码里不规范的注释整理一下。
say.note: 请按检查器的反馈处理。

howto.what_en: After install, whenever an edit finishes and the comment checker flags a comment, it pauses to handle the warning: it first fixes or explains the flagged comment, then continues.
howto.when_en: Triggers after a successful edit-type tool call (apply_patch, write, edit, etc.) when the comment-checker emits a warning.

say_en.text: Fix the comment that was just flagged.
say_en.note: It will fix it and continue.
It will explain and keep going.

say_en.text: Clean up the irregular comments in this code.
